Classifies a location with explosion risk according to RIC No. 12 and lists the allowed types of protection for equipment. Formal classification requires an area drawing showing the extent of each zone.

Shows whether the installation needs an electrical safety program under RIC No. 17 and lists its components and the five golden rules for de-energized work. The standard sets no frequencies: the program defines them from the manufacturer and operating conditions.
